methodologyNotes: Roster covers eleven 2-ton-class (plus one 1.1-ton) hydraulic shop/engine cranes verified 2026-08-12 against manufacturer and authorized-dealer product pages (Torin/Big Red, Sunex, OTC, Harbor Freight/Pittsburgh Automotive, Omega Lift Equipment, Blackhawk Automotive, Vestil, Performance Tool/Wilmar), cross-checked against Global Industrial and independent review sites (KnockOutEngine) where the manufacturer's own page lacked a spec; four adversarial corrections were made to the seed list rather than guessing: (1) "Sunex 7745 4.5-Ton" does not exist in Sunex's current or archived catalog — the seed was replaced with Sunex's actual current 2-ton foldable engine crane, model 5222. (2) "Omega 32020" does not exist — Omega Lift Equipment's real 2-ton engine crane is model 44020, used instead. (3) "Vestil EHN-200" does not exist — Vestil's actual 2,000 lb shop crane/engine hoist is model EHN-20-C, used instead. (4) The generic seed "Blackhawk 2-Ton" was resolved to Blackhawk Automotive's actual current SKU, the BH8026 2-ton foldable engine crane. Three further seed items — "JEGS 2-Ton", "Powerbuilt 2-Ton", "TCE Foldable 2-Ton", and "Ranger RLP-10" — could not be confirmed as real, currently-sold, distinctly-specced products against any manufacturer or authorized-dealer source within this research pass (JEGS and Powerbuilt product pages returned bot-blocked/403 responses with no corroborating spec sheet found elsewhere; no "TCE" branded engine hoist or "Ranger RLP-10" product could be located on any retailer or manufacturer site), so three of the four were dropped rather than fabricated and one (TCE) was replaced with a verified real equivalent, Performance Tool's W41029 2-ton folding engine crane. OTC's 1819 is marketed under the "2 Ton" shop-crane category but its own spec sheet states a 2,200 lb (1.1 ton) rated capacity at full boom retraction, dropping to 1,650 lb at full extension — reported as-is rather than rounded up. priceUsd is left null where no manufacturer or authorized-dealer page displayed a current sale price within this pass (Torin T32001, T32002, Strongway, Dragway Tools LD-3012) rather than guessed from third-party marketplace listings of uncertain currency. accessedAt 2026-08-12 throughout.

products.name: Torin Big Red T32001 2 Ton Hydraulic Engine Hoist
products.priceNote: No current manufacturer or authorized-dealer list price could be confirmed within this research pass; Torin does not sell direct and third-party marketplace prices fluctuate too widely to report as a fixed figure.

specs.boom_reach_positions: 4-hole position reinforced boom: 35-7/16 in./0.5 ton, 42-1/8 in./1 ton, 48-13/16 in./1.5 ton, 55-1/2 in./2 ton

products.provenance: Torin's own owner's manual (hosted on globalindustrial.com/media.hcrcnow.com) and the Northern Tool product listing confirm the 2-ton (4,000 lb) capacity, 4-position reinforced boom with per-position capacity ratings, 1 in.-78.75 in. lift range, 8-ton long-ram hydraulic jack, 6 swivel casters, foldable frame, and 185 lb weight.

products.name: Torin Big Red T32002 2 Ton Hydraulic Engine Hoist with Load Leveler
products.priceNote: No current manufacturer or authorized-dealer list price could be confirmed within this research pass; Torin does not sell direct.

specs.boom_reach_positions: 4-hole position reinforced boom at 2, 1.5, 1, and 0.5 ton settings

products.provenance: Amazon's official Big Red listing plus an independent teardown review (KnockOutEngine) confirm 2-ton capacity, 4-position adjustable boom, 90 in. max lift height with fully extended boom, high-tensile welded-steel square-tube frame, 6 casters (360-degree rotation), a folded footprint reduced by over 30 in., 8-ton hydraulic ram, and a bundled 1,500 lb load leveler distinguishing it from the T32001. Weight approximately 160 lb per the same sources.

Construction material, caster count, and weight are not stated on Sunex's own page and no corroborating source with those figures was found, so left null rather than guessed.

products.name: OTC 1819 2,200 lb. Capacity Fold-Away Heavy-Duty Shop Crane
products.priceNote: OTC's own product page and Summit Racing listing returned bot-blocked responses on direct fetch in this pass; no current price could be confirmed.

specs.boom_reach_positions: Telescoping boom extension for adjustable reach

products.provenance: OTC's own product listing (model 1819) states a 2,200 lb capacity with the boom fully retracted, dropping to 1,650 lb at full boom extension — i.e. a 1.1-ton nominal rating, reported as-is rather than rounded up to match the seed list's "2-ton" framing. Confirmed specs: telescoping fold-away boom, 107 in. retracted / 117 in. extended boom height, 80 in. x 83 in. overall footprint, 27 in. x 38 in. folded footprint, 16-7/8 in. lifting chain, two-speed hydraulic hand pump, adjustable leg spread, roller-bearing steering-dolly wheels, and 454 lb shipping weight. Construction material and exact caster count are not stated on OTC's own page and no corroborating source supplied them, so left null.
